Calls.message: The vpc ID 'vpc-0fd69c587899cccb2' does not exist
Calls.rawResponseBody: InvalidVpcID.NotFoundThe vpc ID 'vpc-0fd69c587899cccb2' does not exist90f19cc7-d1fa-4f25-ac67-28ec76a5e93d

Findings: SG tokens bind vpc-id selection, not the complete filter list: rows21/36/39 accept changed tag filters; rows33/34 reject removing vpc-id; rows37/38 reject adding it; row35 accepts an added tag filter within the same VPC.

SG pagination scans before non-scope filtering: row14 returned 4 groups for MaxResults5, then row16 returned2. Native scan ordering is opaque; resource identity differs from emulator identities, so replay checks page bounds, exhaustion, exact per-resource documents and joined page membership, not native per-page membership when filtering removes candidates.

SG token with omitted MaxResults returns remaining groups without a continuation token (row22). Explicit IDs conflict with NextToken even without MaxResults (rows23/31). Larger page size is accepted (rows17/25).

Region reuse and operation reuse fail InvalidParameterValue (rows18/19/26/27); malformed tokens fail the same code (rows20/28). Cross-account reuse remains unobserved: this probe used only one authorized account.

Subnet changing tag-only filters returns an empty exhausted page (rows29/41), while changing vpc-id to absent tag returns an empty page with a token (row45, corroborating networking row173). Native scan boundaries, not matching-result count alone, determine continuation.

AWS chose us-east-1c for omitted AvailabilityZone in this cohort, versus us-east-1e in networking rows154–164 and us-east-1a earlier. Replay binds the automatically selected AZ name/ID; it does not claim a fixed AWS placement policy.
Token bytes are opaque and may change on repeated SG continuation; only token usability/presence is a stable contract. No claim of identical ciphertext is made.
